auth.webcrypto_note: Sign-in and registration are signed with a non-exportable device key (WebCrypto) and require HTTPS or localhost.
auth.device_already_used: This device has already been bound to an account and cannot register again (contact an admin to release it).
auth.device_bound_to_other_account: This device is bound to another account. Sign in with that account.
auth.registration_closed: Self-registration is closed. Ask an admin to create an account.
